title: 2.1.37 Print Settings Advisor
description: Given filament type and layer height, print a recommended print temperature using else if and logical operators. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed — practice for else if chains (book 2.1.4) and combining conditions (book 2.1.8); scenario named in curriculum-plan §2.1 In-Class Activities: 'print settings advisor'

steps.title: Declare filament and layer height
steps.instructions: Create a variable called filamentType set to 'PLA', 'PETG', or 'ABS', and a variable called layerHeight set to a number of millimeters (e.g. 0.2).

steps.title: Chain the recommendation
steps.instructions: Write an else if chain that checks filamentType and recommends a print temperature: 'PLA' -> 200, 'PETG' -> 235, 'ABS' -> 250, anything else -> log 'Unknown filament type'. Log the recommended temperature.

steps.title: Add a layer-height warning
steps.instructions: Add a separate if statement that uses && or || to warn when layerHeight is outside a safe range (for example, less than 0.1 or greater than 0.4). Log a warning message when that's true.

requirements.title: else if chain present
requirements.description: Code contains an else if chain

requirements.title: logical operator used in a second condition
requirements.description: Code contains an if condition using && or ||
